scenarios.name: fresh-unguarded
scenarios.description: No evidence: trust 0, probation.

scenarios.name: fresh-guarded-unverified
scenarios.description: Guard declared but never reported: G=0.8, no evidence.

scenarios.name: unguarded-capped
scenarios.description: Unguarded entities never reach their 0.5 ceiling (Invariant IV).

scenarios.name: guarded-trusted
scenarios.description: 38 applies, guard passed: trusted.

scenarios.name: guarded-many-applies-no-guard-report
scenarios.description: Enough evidence but guard never reported: not trusted.

scenarios.name: trusted-needs-min-uses
scenarios.description: High score but n < 5: stays active, not trusted.

scenarios.name: guard-failure-quarantines
scenarios.description: Failed guard -> quarantined, trust 0.

scenarios.name: quarantine-recovery-status-lag
scenarios.description: After a failed guard then a pass, the fold recomputes on the previous (quarantined) status so T=0 in that step: storedStatus is probation while a read at `now` derives trusted (spec section 9).

scenarios.name: recency-floor
scenarios.description: A year of idleness decays recency to the 0.3 floor.

scenarios.name: recency-half-life
scenarios.description: One half-life (45d) of idleness.

scenarios.name: skip-never-refreshes-recency
scenarios.description: SKIP leaves n, k and lastSignalAt untouched.

scenarios.name: reject-context-not-a-trial
scenarios.description: REJECT_CONTEXT damps the EMA but no counters.

scenarios.name: retire-by-failure
scenarios.description: n >= 3 and undecayed L*G < 0.1: retired.

scenarios.name: age-alone-never-retires
scenarios.description: A dormant entity is not retired by decay.

scenarios.name: drift-quarantines
scenarios.description: Learned weight moves >= 0.4 from the baseline with n >= 3.

scenarios.name: durability-declared-anchors
scenarios.description: Distinct host anchors raise durability.

scenarios.name: durability-week-fallback
scenarios.description: No anchors: one fallback anchor per calendar week.

scenarios.name: durability-capped
scenarios.description: Durability saturates at 1.5.

scenarios.name: kind-override-thresholds
scenarios.description: Per-kind minUsesForTrusted=50 keeps a well-evidenced entity active.

scenarios.name: kind-override-recency
scenarios.description: Per-kind half-life 10d, floor 0.5.

scenarios.name: kind-override-unguarded-ceiling
scenarios.description: Ceiling 0.3 binds (raw ~0.456) and is clamped strictly below: 0.299999.

scenarios.name: signal-value-weighting
scenarios.description: Weighted evidence: ADOPTED(0.6) adds 0.6 to n and k.

scenarios.name: mixed-history
scenarios.description: Applies interleaved with rejects and a late guard pass.

scenarios.name: guard-kind-change
scenarios.description: A guard report may rename the guard kind; 'none' makes it unguarded.
